sourceIdentity.note: The working tree includes the merged continuation. These file digests bind this local source cut; the contextual Git HEAD is not presented as the exact tested published commit.

implementation.scope: Service.sendMessage consumes the rollback callbacks after proving absence of both a matching command receipt and the command outbox row. Other admission/lifecycle callers are unchanged.
rollbackOrder: Undo only exact entry/input/basis references advanced by the failed transaction; accepted claims remain claimed.
Undo only the newly acquired claim if entry, phase, input and original basis references still match.
invariants: No asynchronous callback was introduced into Store.command.
Existing accepted-command receipt and pending-command idempotency remain intact.
Original owner/account/epoch/grant basis is retained, never replaced with current authority after failure.
Source captures, source refs, selected bytes and grants are not changed by rollback.
Removed/replaced, finalizing/finalized or more recently advanced custody is not reopened.

independentReview.outcome: No remaining actionable defect found in the narrow change.
resolvedFindings: Rollback originally covered only the newly claimed entry, leaving other advanced entries stale after a late COMMIT failure.
A fresh unconsumed claim undo originally lacked an exact original-basis guard and could rewind a newer admission transition.

cases.name: Explicit first-source account admission
cases.coverage: M04 enabled, explicit requestContextId, forced sourceAccountAdmission persistence failure; no message/outbox/account/witness commit, unchanged capture, same command/preparation retry dispatches once.

cases.name: Early projection failure
cases.coverage: A synchronous message projection failure leaves the original preparation retryable after proven rollback.

cases.name: Late COMMIT failure
cases.coverage: SQLite COMMIT fails after the input callback and advanceAdmission; the original preparation identity and basis remain usable on retry.

cases.name: Committed acknowledgement failure
cases.coverage: A matching durable receipt acknowledges the accepted command; no claim is reopened and dispatch remains valid.

cases.name: Original authority fences
cases.coverage: After rollback, changing logical owner, epoch, or resource grant still rejects the old preparation.

cases.name: Other accepted request
cases.coverage: A later failed claim and retry leave an already accepted request consumed and deliver each accepted input once.

cases.name: Queued Service integration
cases.coverage: An accepted pre-epoch queued input remains dispatchable after a later same-model message fails at COMMIT. This integration case already passed before shared-basis undo because its before/after basis values are equal.

cases.name: Shared custody lifecycle rollback
cases.coverage: A RequestContextCustody plus real SQLite transaction fixture explicitly changes admissionDigest. Late COMMIT failure must restore every exactly touched claimed basis while keeping the older accepted preparation claimed. This owner-contract case reproduced the shared-basis defect.

cases.name: Stale callback and newer advance
cases.coverage: An unused newly acquired claim undo and an earlier advance undo cannot rewind a newer basis. Consumed callbacks cannot undo a subsequent claim with the same input ID. Finalized custody remains intact.
